Operations.Value: A 'mosaic frequency' resonance mechanism has been established using arranged quartz shards instead of a single intact crystal.
The barrier's absorption limit is currently holding after consuming the local source without shattering the seal again.
The group has established a plan to wait for confirmation from the Watchfort before moving on.
The barrier's violet glow is now steady and uniform, no longer flickering or chaotic.
The group has purchased time by stabilizing the operation for hours rather than minutes.
The barrier functions as a circuit created by shards and willpower rather than a single pipe or stone.
Kaelen's gauntlet previously hummed with a sick, erratic vibration; it is now still, cold, and heavy, then re-ignited with a faint rhythmic pulse.

The flow of Blight was previously controlled by Kaelen's mental will alone and physically restricted by Maren and Torin holding a hammer handle; it is now distributed across multiple shards with Kaelen guiding the flow without forcing it.
The operation previously relied on brute force or a single tuning key; it now utilizes a mosaic frequency circuit to regulate the flood sustainably.
The barrier has consumed the local source and is currently holding its absorption limit.
The group is currently resting at the Gate of Silence shrine location.
The barrier's light has faded from chaotic black and amber to a steady, uniform violet glow.
The green light from the shrine fissure has dimmed further into a deep indigo.
Elias Thorne's side wound reopened during the resonance surge but is currently not bleeding.
Elias Thorne is monitoring the barrier and directing the group's efforts to stabilize the flow using the mosaic frequency.
Elias Thorne believes they have bought time by stabilizing the operation for hours.
Kaelen's brass gauntlet re-ignited with a faint rhythmic pulse matching the hum of the barrier.
